<!-- Record locked protocol-stack and TLS inputs, licenses and guest redistribution boundaries. -->
# M10 third-party inputs

- smoltcp 0.12.0, BSD-0-Clause, from crates.io and the
  [upstream project](https://github.com/smoltcp-rs/smoltcp/tree/v0.12.0).
  Cargo.lock records the crate checksum. Disabled defaults exclude std, host
  devices, async and other unused protocols. Enabled features are alloc,
  medium-ethernet, proto-ipv4, socket-tcp and socket-udp.
- Mbed TLS 2.28.10, unmodified upstream commit
  `2fc8413bfcb51354c8e679141b17b3f1a5942561`, from
  [Mbed-TLS/mbedtls](https://github.com/Mbed-TLS/mbedtls/tree/v2.28.10).
  The upstream LICENSE is copied verbatim into `/etc/mbedtls.LICENSE`; the project
  uses its Apache-2.0 option. It is linked into pkg/tls-test user binaries,
  never into the kernel. Build flags and verification are in xtask/src/packages.rs.
  This is a controlled compatibility fixture, not a claim of production TLS policy.
- musl 1.2.4-2 remains pinned to the M9 runtime digest and its existing
  [musl notices](musl.md). The current BusyBox source archive and GPL notice
  must still accompany redistribution as documented in [LICENSING](../LICENSING.md).

The image also contains the complete smoltcp BSD-0-Clause notice and the Rust
transitive dependency notices used by the network stack. These notices are read
from the Cargo registry sources matching Cargo.lock; no upstream license text
is rewritten or assigned a first-party license.

The local HTTPS certificates are generated test data. Test private keys stay on
the host under ignored build/compat/tls-fixture; only public certificates enter
the image. No external account credentials or signing keys are packaged.
